name: Fast Neighbourhood Access via Delta Lookup Tables
definition: A method to access immediate neighbours of a voxel in Morton-ordered memory without re-encoding coordinates, using precomputed offset tables that map a coordinate component to the memory stride required to reach its neighbour.
summary: Fast Neighbourhood Access via Delta Lookup Tables accelerates voxel neighbor retrieval in Morton-ordered memory by using precomputed offset tables to avoid expensive coordinate decoding and re-encoding.
